description: Post-IPO lock-up release dates for names in the put universe. Read by the V7/V8 engine when put_skip_lockup = 1: no new put on a name with a release between today and the put's expiry + put_lockup_window_days. Not available via the Robinhood MCP — curated by hand from the prospectus / news when a recently-IPO'd name enters the universe (see /refresh step 9b). Past dates are harmless; the engine only looks forward.

SPCX.note: 180-day lock-up expiry (IPO 2026-06-11); Musk's block stays locked to June 2027
